title: THE SETTLING: time to settle, the first orders, the first contact on a clock
context: Owner, 2026-11-08, notes 4-6 on the landing's third look: "4) we will delay the arrival of the first enemies, first we leave time to settle, 5) the player chooses what to build first with limited building material, the Stalheart being non-negotiable. 5) Isao tells the player that we will need to scout for more building material, rocks, crystals, liquid, biomass... essentially we delay the first encounter." His two calls: the first choice on the EXISTING build board with its two picks, and the first enemies on a TIMER after the landing, not tied to the scouting. Before: the sinkhole opened quiet at the deploy, Isao printed the Rotor from the landing's stock, the first enemies were up ~20 s after the deploy and the seat ~45 s after the page was ready. Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-08-the-settling-design.md, plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-08-the-settling.md, branch the-settling from 39f98d63, unpushed.
outcome: BUILT (ef67c1c2, 514b9f24, cb10c5c0 and the suite's commit). On the story's own start (an arrival from `landed`): no quiet breach at the deploy; a settle of STORY_SETTLE.seconds 120 on the beats' clock (?settle=N); the deploy grants the whole salvage at once (180 kg automatic or HARD, 240 CLEAN, 96 WRECK; the barrels grant nothing after); the gate (4 s) and the Stålheart (75 s) print from the deploy; after the landers' tour THE FIRST ORDERS open once over the paused game (src/fx/first-orders.js, build-board first(go), firstOffers, BUILD_BOARD.first): the Rotor 45 on the plan's socket, the pad 60, the recycler's work 40 (pays 60 when it stands), the array 120, two picks; Isao's scout_material as it closes; an unordered Rotor at the settle's end is Isao's own (rotor_emergency); then the tremor, the quiet breach with the head start, the override, the seat. GS01 comes on station at `settled` when a settled opening skips construction. The suite found two lines dropped by the brief panel's one-deep slot and both now go through briefs.want (src/td-tab.js, existing lines): scout_material (the panel busy with the Stålheart's lines as the card closes; dropped on one run of two) and gunship_overhead (with the Quiver's clear while quiver_cleared holds the panel). Measured: the card at the beats' clock 10.8 s (the tour takes 10.4 s), Isao's book at that moment has the gate printed and the Stålheart claimed, so a bought Rotor stands after the Stålheart at ~92 s, not before it as spec 2.C expected; the tremor waits for it (92.8 s on a 12 s settle) and on the 120 s default still comes at the settle. Sector 0 does not play on the default opening (the Stålheart stands at ~90 s) nor on the &settle=10 pages (the emergency Rotor waits behind the Stålheart there). Deviations from the plan: GS01 at `settled` on a settled opening only; the bonus barrels one grant; the suite's skip page at &settle=16, not 8 (the tour outlasts an 8 s settle). --grow rewritten to the settled order (and its step list given the depot of round 8), --opening-cuts on &settle=10.
alternatives: The first choice as a new card of its own: the owner chose the existing board, its keys and its two picks.
The first enemies tied to the scouting (the rover's first trip): the owner chose a timer; the scouting is Isao's line only this round.
The Stålheart waiting for the Rotor as before (`when: rotor-ready`): the Stålheart is non-negotiable and the settle is the time it prints in.
The salvage dripping in per barrel with the board opened at the last barrel: the card would wait on the AFR-01's minute; the whole salvage at the deploy lets it open as the tour ends.

Putting a bought Rotor ahead of the Stålheart in Isao's book (tried in this round: an `ahead` order option): no effect, the Stålheart is already claimed when the card opens; holding the Stålheart until the card closes is the owner's call.
